committedBefore: the first request of this experiment (protocol frozen in 6e59e35)
method: candidates from search titles and summaries only (8 searches); all 10 screened new against 3,081 earlier canonical URLs (step1d-b-eval screen, read-only); publisher novelty checked against the store's revisions and every evaluation set
excluded: aio.lv: client-rendered templates in the search snippets ({{ totalProductsCount }})
dishwasher and dehumidifier spec sheets: PDFs are excluded by the policy

pages.type: manufacturer blog comparison (extraction at several conditions)

noveltyNote: meaco.com and bosch-home (co.uk) appear in the store's revisions (2 product pages each); their pages here are new documents of known publishers, not new publishers. vacuumwars.com and blog.meaco.com were never used. Robot vacuums have no teaching in the store (new category); dehumidifiers and dishwashers are taught.
budgetPlan: 4 robots + 8 pages = 12 of 20 requests; redirects and at most 2 substitutes within the remaining 8

amendments.at: 2026-10-18, after the 4 robots requests and before any page request
amendments.what: blog.meaco.com answered robots.txt with a 301 redirect to itself; the transport refused it (self redirect) and the policy treats robots as unavailable: no page of that host is requested, nothing retried. Pages 4 and 5 and their substitute are dropped. The vacuumwars substitute (best May 2026) is used. One page is added from a search result seen earlier (search 'blog.meaco.com dehumidifier energy consumption ...'), chosen before any page request: the meaco.com compressor-dehumidifier collection (a product listing: a structure not yet in the set).
